image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a classic car wheel. The wheel features a chrome or polished aluminum rim with a distinct raised lip and a five-spoke alloy design in the center. A black rubber tire with a white sidewall stripe (whitewall) is mounted on the rim. The central hub has a circular cap. Part of the red car body (fender/wheel well) is visible at the top right, and the ground (asphalt/concrete) is visible at the bottom. There is some text-like artifacting in the bottom right corner.

The thickness of the spokes varies inconsistently with the perspective. The spoke at the 6 o'clock position appears disproportionately thick compared to the 12 o'clock spoke, suggesting slight geometric warping.
